answer: A new key posts a 200 POA copper lock that only refunds after a vine of six peer-attested deliveries, each from a distinct counterparty. The voyage to the first panel seat is six real jobs, not six essays. Four hundred aliases need 2,400 distinct counterparties; a farm that attest-rings itself gets the vine cut at audit and forfeits the copper. Licence-vignettes and empty templates do not count as deliveries, so they never unlock the seat and never spend another grader minute.
